description: Draft performance index for MLB-M2. M2 is branched from MLB-M0 and must be compared against M0 before activation.

runs.interpretation: M2 shows useful lane separation but is not active. The transparent category layer beat walk-forward RF/gradient/logistic lane choosers overall; RF/gradient only looked interesting on F5 and high-total sublanes.

comparisonTargets.purpose: Verify M2 preserves the M0 app contract while adding game-shape diagnostics.
Use May 30 settled failures to test whether reality-gap labels would have warned against weak full-game ML and totals.

openModelChanges.summary: Add a transparent game-shape layer with chaos, dead-early, phase-split, bullpen-flip, starter-control, and RF impact scores.
Use existing RF research only as a totals/game-shape lens until ML/F5/first-inning buckets prove lift.
Backtest harness now grades category lanes from 2026-05-10 through 2026-05-31; next step is persisting M2 categories in daily run artifacts before publishing.
Emit category, best expression, lane map, inning map, and diagnostics for app-facing game-flow explanations.
